lines.text: Many learners say: I stayed home because of I was sick.
Better: I stayed home because I was sick.
Use because before a full sentence.
Because! I was late because I missed the bus.

data.wrong: I stayed home because of I was sick.
data.right: I stayed home because I was sick.
data.why: Use because before a full sentence.

quiz.stem: I was late ___ I missed the bus.

native.tip: “की वजह से” सुनकर लोग because of बोल देते हैं। पूरे वाक्य से पहले because आता है; of के साथ चीज़ आती है, जैसे because of rain।
native.caption: क्या आप भी बोलते हैं: “I stayed home because of I was sick.” 😅 सही वाक्य है: “I stayed home because I was sick.” ध्यान रखें: पूरे वाक्य से पहले because आता है, of नहीं। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “because”। याद रखें: पूरे वाक्य से पहले because आता है, of नहीं। अब अपना एक वाक्य ज़ोर से बोलिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners add of. Before a full sentence use because. Use because of with a thing, like because of rain.
en.caption: Do you say: “I stayed home because of I was sick.” 😅 The right sentence is: “I stayed home because I was sick.” Remember: Before a full sentence, use because. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
